lines.zh: 我迈着整齐的步子前进
lines.en: I advance with even, tidy steps.

lines.zh: 蓝色的黏土在阳光下亮
lines.en: Blue clay shines in the sun.
I walk a straight line by the wall.
My armor plates clink.
I make for the front of the line.

lines.zh: 我每一步都落在同一格
lines.en: Each step falls in the same place.
I pass sideways through a narrow door.
I look up; the banner stirs.
I make a circuit of the yard.
The ground I cross stays tidy.
I head for my two companions.
I change direction and go on.
Hands on hips, I stand straight.

lines.zh: 蓝色的染料让黏土更硬
lines.en: The blue dye made my clay harder.

lines.zh: 我在看那面旗有没有歪
lines.en: I'm checking whether the banner tilts.
I set my shoulder plate straight.
I'm counting who's missing from the line.
My stick stands at my feet.
Wind flattens my little banner.

lines.zh: 我的颜色在黏土里最深
lines.en: My blue runs deepest in the clay.
I lower a hand, then raise it.
I'm waiting for the next command.
I give you a soldier's salute.
State your business first.
I stand third in the line.

lines.zh: 你从右边过来，我看见了
lines.en: You came from the right. I noticed.
My stick is only a stick.
But I've used it a few times.
Want to view the ranks? Stand back.
Orders come from above, not from you.
I tilt my head at your boots.

lines.zh: 你靴上的泥，沾到我的色。
lines.en: The mud on your boots smears my paint.
A man with muddy boots won't get far.
I'll watch first, and not strike.

lines.zh: 我的甲片上多了一道痕
lines.en: A new mark on my armor plate.
I step back and stand to attention.
A small piece of clay comes off.
I press the crack shut.
The wood split; my hand is steady.
My clay cracks; I make no sound.
The line hasn't broken.
I can still stand here.
I shift my armor back into place.
No withdrawal order. I don't retreat.
Clay soldiers don't eat.
Blue clay has no mouth to open.
That won't upgrade me.
Leather and stick are what help.

lines.zh: 你举着它，我就站着不动。
lines.en: Hold it up, and I stand still.
Put the blue-dyed clay away.
I've a task here.

lines.zh: 这个换成羊毛还差不多
lines.en: Trade that for wool and we'll talk.
I need no feeding, only orders.

lines.zh: 蓝色染料把我染成这样
lines.en: Blue dye made me this colour
Knocked askew, I straighten at once.
You've blocked my route.
I go around; I didn't push you.
My armor grazed your leg.
I step back and re-form.
A blue clay fist doesn't count.
My clay takes a dent.
I raise a hand for you to move.
Let's pass each other once more.
You'd best step to the wall.
The ranks are my home.

lines.zh: 我们一起成形，一起行动
lines.en: We form together and move together.
Take my left; I'll cover it.
Three of us can hold a gate.
I needn't any other company.
I know your paint.
Same banner, same march.

lines.zh: 黏土干裂之前，我们都站着
lines.en: We stand until our clay cracks.
If you fall, I take your place.

lines.zh: 这就是我们唯一的方式
lines.en: That's the only way we have.
I pick up a scrap of leather.
This could patch my armor.
I press it onto my shoulder.
I can't lift things too heavy.
I pick up a piece of glowstone.
This should go to upgrading.
I tuck it in my belt pouch.
You dropped it? I'll keep it.
These aren't mine.
I set it down in the middle of the line.
I raise my stick.
I call out along the line.
The others turn around.
I fix on the one in front.
Eight paces to go.

lines.zh: 蓝色的黏土，也是一块一块的。
lines.en: Blue clay, still in pieces.
My plates ring as I move.
It hasn't fallen back.
A blue soldier like me is rarely chosen.
I quicken my step.
My stick is across my body.
Five paces now.
I ready myself to strike.
My companion is on my left.
I edge a little to the left.
It turns its head to follow.
I signal my companion to take the right.
We close in together.
It retreats, and my blue paint holds.
My clay hardens further.
Dyed blue, still a soldier.
That's close enough.
I go first, without a battle cry.
My stick is at shoulder height.
It has raised a guard.
I strike exactly at the guard.
It staggers a step back.
My companion fills in.
Now it's caught between us.
I strike at the back of its knee.
My companion slams in from the side.
My blue clay fist lands solid.
It stumbles a step forward.
I withdraw and give up the spot.
I add another blow.
My stick has split.
I still hold it. It still works.
It lifts a foot to crush me.
I roll clear.
I take my place in the line again.
The line hasn't broken.
It's fallen back. We hold.
Plant the stick on the ground.
We've won this round.
But the order hasn't been withdrawn.

lines.zh: 我被放在地上，立起来了
lines.en: I'm set down, and I stand.
My blue clay is still damp.

lines.zh: 我看了看旁边两个同伴
lines.en: I look at my two companions.
One black, one brown, and I'm blue.
I press a hand to my chest.
My clay is soft, but it will set.
Someone hands me a stick.
I raise it and test the weight.

lines.zh: 我站到了队伍的第三个
lines.en: I take the third place in the line.
The yard is very quiet.
The clay is still soft. Waiting for an order.
Then I move.

lines.zh: 火让我的蓝色褪了一层
lines.en: Fire faded my blue a shade.

lines.zh: 摔下来，我的腿碎了一角
lines.en: Falling, a corner of my leg broke off.
Soaked, my clay turns soft.
The blast throws me to the wall.

lines.zh: 一根箭钉进了我的护甲
lines.en: An arrow lodges in my armor.

lines.zh: 这股术力让我的黏土发热
lines.en: This spell heats my clay.
I don't eat, but my clay dries and cracks.
Lightning fires my clay hard.
I break into blue dust and fall.
